explanation: The remake was unlicensed, and Kurosawa's studio won a settlement. His Seven Samurai (1954) inspired a different western, The Magnificent Seven (1960).

claims.text: A Fistful of Dollars (1964) is an unlicensed remake of Akira Kurosawa's Yojimbo (1961).
Seven Samurai, Rashomon and Throne of Blood were not the source of A Fistful of Dollars.
Kurosawa's side took legal action over the unlicensed remake and won a settlement.
Seven Samurai (1954) was remade as the western The Magnificent Seven (1960).
